{{av}}

This building is the fundamental building of the researches available. Each reaction researches a different building in several steps, each with a chance to fail and a chance to produce a random breakthrough. These breakthroughs allow you to build the more advanced buildings. Once the [[School of wizardry | School of Wizardry]] is researched and built further research in [[Magic | magic]] can occur there.
